title: The integral constructible category and its heart
statement:
Let $k$ be a field of characteristic $p>0$, let $\ell$ be a prime different from $p$, and let $X$ be a separated scheme of finite type over $k$, as in [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be finite, with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\pi_E$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Coefficients are the completed ring sheaf $R_X=\mathcal O_{E,X}=p_X^*\underline{\mathcal O_E}$ of [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], and the ambient category is the ordinary unbounded derived category $D(\operatorname{Mod}(R_X))$ of [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories]. Use the constructibility and bounded constructibility of [sk-def-sfb-constructible], the standard truncations of [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category], and the fixed-universe size convention [def-weil-size-convention].

1. $\Dbc(X,\mathcal O_E)$ is a full triangulated subcategory of $D(\operatorname{Mod}(R_X))$ in the sense of [def-weil-triangulated-subcategory]. Its objects are bounded, and it is stable under the standard truncations.
2. $\Cons(X,\mathcal O_E)$ identifies with the objects of $\Dbc(X,\mathcal O_E)$ concentrated in degree $0$. It is an abelian full subcategory of $\operatorname{Mod}(R_X)$: kernels and cokernels of its morphisms, computed in $\operatorname{Mod}(R_X)$, belong to it. It is closed under extensions and essentially small (its isomorphism classes form a set in the chosen universe).

proof.text: The field $k$ has only the ideals $0,k$, so $\operatorname{Spec}k$ is locally Noetherian. The finite-type structure map makes $X$ locally Noetherian by [pqf-lem-locnoeth-lft] and quasi-compact by [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]; hence $X$ is Noetherian. The integral-model equivalence [sk-lem-integral-models](2) identifies membership in $\Dbc$ with the predicate $P$ of [lem-sfb-integral-residue-class-triangle-closure], for the same completed ring $R_X$. That lemma gives zero, isomorphism, shift and ambient triangle closure of this predicate. Transporting those properties through the equivalence gives the full triangulated subcategory criterion [def-weil-triangulated-subcategory], including the inherited triangles and exact inclusion.

Objects are bounded by the cohomological definition [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. Both standard truncations preserve them by [det-lem-int-integral-heart-local-model](3). Its clause (2) gives $H^q(K)[0]\in\Dbc$ for every $K\in\Dbc$ and integer $q$.

Apply [lem-sfb-derived-degree-zero-abelian-criterion] to $\mathcal A=\operatorname{Mod}(R_X)$ and $\mathcal T=\Dbc$, with the triangle closure of step 1 and the cohomology closure of step 2. The ambient category is abelian by [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. The cohomological definition [sk-def-sfb-constructible] identifies its $\mathcal B$ with $\Cons$, since $C[0]$ has just the cohomology sheaf $C$. The criterion therefore gives exactly the degree-zero identification on objects and morphisms, abelianness, ambient kernels and cokernels, and extension closure.

source.place: Paragraph (2), degree-zero heart and ambient exact structure

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-stratified-constant-model-product-bound] with the Noetherian scheme from step 1 and the given integral coefficients and universe bound. Every constructible sheaf embeds into one of its $P_j$ and is therefore isomorphic to an image subsheaf of $P_j$. The lemma supplies a set of these images over the set of $j$. Retain the constructible ones: this is still a set and represents every object of $\Cons$. Thus its isomorphism classes form a set in the chosen universe, including the zero sheaf on empty $X$.
